About Us
We are a creative team combining coding, storytelling, and media art. Our vision: make the world better through unity—and hopefully discover a star or planet and name it Holzfuß.

Who we need:

We’re looking for an Astrophysicist (or space science background) to help ground our ideas in real science and analyze data.

If you bring the science and want to build something impactful with an ambitious, creative team, join us!
